metadata.name: crop_kg_pack_template
metadata.scope: Local crop-pack knowledge graph for minor-grain breeding hypotheses. Claims are evidence clues that require source-aware validation.
metadata.source_boundary: Use DOI, URL, local-rag URI, local experiment record ID, or advisor-confirmed record. Do not add unsupported claims.
metadata.maintainer_notes: Copy this file to docs/templates/<crop_key>_kg_seed.json, fill nodes and edges, validate with scripts/validate_crop_kg.py, then register it in [knowledge.crop_kg_packs].
